fusions.name: Reef-Cut Plunge
fusions.desc: Plunges onto a target up to 7 tiles away for 12 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at the full 7 tiles, knocking it back 2 tiles and making it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Whole Colony Aloft
fusions.desc: Sends 5 seabirds out in a spread, each dealing 6 damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Atoll Roost
fusions.desc: Takes 1 second to cast. Raises a reef outcrop that stands for 15 seconds; the seabirds nesting on it strike an enemy within 4 tiles for 5 damage every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Calcified Plumage
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 8%, and you have 10% water resistance.
